originalFunctionalRole: A concealed defensive structure that waits beneath a copper hatch, then rises to aim focused emberseed pulses at nearby intruders.
lore: At the alderwood river workshop, Ilyra winds a young emberseed into a copper coil and seals it beneath a hatch beside the sluice.
When raider boots shake the roots, the seed glows and the hatch lifts a riveted lookout to guard the waterwheel.
portraitBrief: Create an original square painted card thumbnail centered on a copper hatch opening to reveal a compact coil tower with a bright emberseed core; frame it with a few alder leaves, river spray, and workshop timber, using bold large shapes that remain distinct when reduced to card-thumbnail size, with no lettering or marks.

hiddenVsRevealedArenaForm.hidden: A low round copper hatch sits flush with the arena floor, its broad rim and three dark rivet heads surrounding a single warm emberseed slit.
hiddenVsRevealedArenaForm.revealed: The hatch opens into a short, sturdy lookout tower with a three-footed silhouette, a bright central emberseed, and two thick copper coil rings crowning the mast.

teamplate: Keep the existing north/south team color on a clear frontmost baseplate beneath the copper body; keep the tower metal and emberseed palette shared by both sides.
readabilityCriteria: At the real 13 px arena silhouette, the hidden form reads as a flat round hatch while the revealed form reads as a raised three-footed tower with a coil crown.
The team-colored baseplate remains visible at normal arena scale, so side identity survives independently of the shared copper palette.
Use large solid shapes and a single bright emberseed focal point; do not rely on tiny runes, thin highlights, lettering, or glow alone to distinguish the forms.
